summary: Frontend testing of Care Home Enquiries overlay on Franchisee Detail page (Monica Diodato febd57cf...). Login → navigation → panel-map → toggle ON/OFF, all 4 date presets, custom date inputs, row rendering, and hover highlight all verified. Territory map still renders (existing widget not broken). 3 expected pins for Monica appear ONLY under 'All time' preset; the default '12m' preset returns 0 pins because her enquiries are historical (2021 & 2022). Behavior is technically correct.

issues: Default preset '12m' shows '0 enquiries plotted' for Monica because her 3 care-home enquiries are dated 2021-02-08 and 2022-10-05 (outside a 365-day window). All 3 pins DO load correctly when the user clicks 'All time'. Consider: (a) auto-fallback to 'All time' when the 12m result is empty, or (b) show an empty-state hint like 'No enquiries in this range — try All time' inside the list card so admins understand why it's empty. This is a UX polish, not a bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: consider auto-selecting 'All time' when 12m returns 0 pins, or add a helper hint linking to 'All time' from the empty-state message so admins don't miss historical enquiries.
No blocking issues — feature is functional and matches the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay component (~175 LOC) lives inside FranchiseeDetailPage.js which is already ~1200+ lines. Recommend extracting to /app/frontend/src/components/franchisee/CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay.jsx for maintainability and to keep FranchiseeDetailPage under the 700-line file-size guideline.
The useEffect dependency array on the fetch effect includes range.from and range.to which correctly re-fires on preset changes — good.

The `hovered` state on map pins is not surfaced by TerritoryMap yet (only `hoveredExtraPinId` is passed through). Confirm FranchiseeTerritoryWidget → TerritoryMap actually consumes hoveredExtraPinId to style the pin — this was not visually verified because pin hover state is subtle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Care Home overlay lives inside CareHomeEnquiriesOverlay in /app/frontend/src/pages/FranchiseeDetailPage.js. Data-testids used: care-home-overlay-toggle, care-home-overlay-count, care-home-overlay-preset-30d/12m/custom/all, care-home-overlay-from/-to, care-home-overlay-list, care-home-overlay-row-<id>. Backend GET /api/contacts/map?source=care_home_enquiry&franchisee_id=febd57cf-600d-4b44-bebc-6a9177984832 returns 3 pins with date_added values 2021-02-08 and 2022-10-05, so only 'All time' preset shows them for that franchisee. Login flow: after signing in, admin lands on '/' (not '/dashboard') — do NOT use wait_for_url('**/dashboard**'). Also do NOT use wait_until='networkidle' on franchisee detail page (map polling keeps network busy) — use 'domcontentloaded'.

test_evidence.custom_inputs_visible: care-home-overlay-from + care-home-overlay-to render when Custom clicked
test_evidence.toggle_off: list unmounts, territory-map remains, extraPins = null
test_evidence.territory_map_intact: territory-map data-testid present before + after toggle
